the livelihood impacts of the oil palm industry on rural communities in Indonesia have been mixed but that the industry can be made more equitable and sustainable through the implementation of specific policies.

the livelihood impacts of smallholder oil palm expansion in Indonesia and the factors which have influenced the outcomes of this expansion.
the social impacts of oil palm expansion, specifically the livelihood impacts and the causes and nature of conflicts that have emerged in the oil palm sector in Indonesia.
the livelihood impacts of palm oil production in Indonesia.
